services.name: Island Adventure Eco Tour - Kayak and Paddleboard
services.desc: 3 hours 15 minute paddle and safety instruction 45 minute light to moderate paddle to island 1 hour exploring island 45 minute light to moderate paddle back from island 15 minutes to exit water and say goodbyes Please Show up 15 minutes in advance of booked time Tour includes: Tour guide and all paddling equipment Life Jackets Lightweight carbon fiber paddles and top of the line kayaks Shell hunting on Island Explore island and play in water Blue Crab Catching when possible Chance to try paddle-boarding Wildlife Viewing Bottled Water Provided Scheduled for best tide Launch from 3 Hours • Guided tour to coastal island • Kayak or SUP • Lesson included

services.name: Salt Marsh Maze Eco Tour - Kayak and Paddleboard
services.desc: 2 hours Please show up 15 minutes in advance of scheduled time. About Take a tour of North Myrtle Beach’s maze-like Salt Marsh -Our guides will show you in and out of naturally winding paths of marsh grass to the best parts of the area. At least one guide is with your group at all times and is prepared to help in any situation. Beautiful nature and opportunity to see a wide range of wild life. Each tour includes a how to kayak and Stand-up paddle-board lesson and demo. Easy for beginners because of calm waters and top of the line kayaks and paddles Bottle water provided Relaxing but 2 Hours • Guided tour through salt marsh maze • Lesson included •

services.name: Wyndham Seawatch Surf Lessons
services.desc: 1.5 Hours About Come and learn to surf with Kokopelli Surf Camp. You will be taught how to surf by one of our professional surfers with 10-plus years of surfing experience, CPR and First Aid certifications, and full knowledge of ocean safety. We begin each lesson with water safety, surfing etiquette, and a stretch to guarantee a fun and safe lesson. After warming up, we demonstrate the proper way to paddle and stand up on the surfboard, allowing the student(s) to practice on the beach before moving to the ocean. We then take the lesson to the water where our surf instructor works 1.5 Hours • Group lesson for kids and adults in front of Sea Watch Resort
